feature.summary: While a reply is running, a message you type waits in a queue (shown as a Queued row with Edit and Cancel) and is sent when the reply ends. Unsent text is also kept as a draft per conversation. Web syncs drafts across devices. VS Code marks each message Sending, Queued, Running, Steered, Not sent or Cancelled.

purpose.what_it_does: Holds follow-up messages written during a running reply, shows them as waiting, and sends them when the turn ends. Keeps unsent composer text for each conversation so leaving and returning does not lose it (apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ChatComposerNew.tsx:3951-3972,4342-4420).
purpose.why_it_exists: People think of the next question while the model is still answering. They also leave chats half-written. Without a queue and a draft the text is lost or the send is blocked. [inferred]
purpose.who_uses_it: Everyone who chats; developers on VS Code, CLI and Chrome use the same ideas in their own forms.
problems_solved: A second message typed during a reply is not lost.
Unsent text survives switching chats, reloads and, on web, other devices.
A failed or cancelled send is visible as its own state (VS Code).
use_cases: Type a follow-up while a long answer streams; it appears as 'Queued: <text>' and goes out when the answer ends.
Click Edit on a queued row to change it, or Cancel to drop it.
Half-write a message, open another chat, come back and find the text there.
Edit the same draft on two web tabs and choose which version to keep.

where_to_find_it: Web composer: a list labelled 'Queued messages' above the input with rows 'Queued: <text>' (or 'Queued 1 of 2: <text>'), and buttons Edit and Cancel, and Steer when the running reply can take it (ChatComposerNew.tsx:5009-5063).

Hosted desktop: same as web (doc: AGENTS.md section 5). Tauri desktop: a section labelled 'Follow-up messages' with rows 'Queued', 'Steering' or 'Not sent' and buttons Edit, Send now, Remove (packages/ui/unified-chat/src/components/FollowUpQueue.tsx).
Mobile: rows with accessibility labels 'Queued message n of m: <text>', 'Edit queued message', 'Cancel queued message' (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/ChatInput.tsx:1857-1902).

VS Code: your message bubble has a dashed border and a caption Sending, Queued, Running, Steered, Not sent or Cancelled; queued ones have Edit and Cancel icons (apps/extension-vscode/src/features/sidebar-webview/webviewContent.ts:624-690,5554-5591).
Chrome side panel: list 'Queued messages' with 'Queued: <text>', Edit, Cancel (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts:15312-15364; apps/extension/_locales/en/messages.json).
CLI: the hint line shows '· 1 message queued' or 'N messages queued' while a turn runs (apps/cli/src/tui/tui_app.rs:2064-2075).

Drafts: web 'Choose which draft to keep' dialog with 'Here' and 'Elsewhere' and buttons 'Use the other version' and 'Keep this version' (apps/web/features/chat/components/DraftConflictDialog.tsx:67-93).
prerequisites: Queue: a reply must be running (isTurnActive).

established.statement: A message sent while a reply is still running is shown as queued (not yet sent) until it goes out.
While a user message is not yet accepted by the service, it shows a pending, sending or queued state.
Unsent composer text is kept as a draft per conversation, separate from sent messages, and a failed send returns to the composer as an unsent draft.
The composer holds a list of queued follow-ups and sends them when the stream ends.
The draft is saved as its own field, never as part of the message list, with a revision to detect conflicts; temporary chats store no draft.
Saves are debounced and retried up to 3 times; a conflict can be resolved by keeping mine or theirs.
Drafts are not synced for conversations that hold Local-model turns.
Local, own key and Cloud are separate trust boundaries; nothing may silently route a Local chat to another boundary.

acceptance_criteria: Sending while a reply runs shows a 'Queued' row and the box clears.
Edit on a queued row puts its text back; sending again replaces that slot, not adds one.
Cancel removes the row and sends nothing.
When the reply ends the first queued message is sent exactly once.
Typing in a stored chat, waiting about 2 seconds, and opening the same chat on another device shows the same draft (web).
Editing the same draft on two devices produces the 'Choose which draft to keep' dialog with both versions.
A temporary chat never stores a draft on the server.
After 3 failed saves a persistent toast with Retry appears.

steps.what_happens: Person presses send while a turn is active; the composer stores the send arguments with the conversation id and clears the box.
When the turn ends, the composer sends the first queued item in the same conversation; items for another conversation become a draft and a notice.
Draft text is parked in the web chat store and in browser storage as the person types.
After the debounce the sync hook PUTs the draft with its revision to the conversation route; the server writes draft and draft_updated_at or answers 409 with the current draft.
A conflict opens a toast and dialog; the person keeps this version or the other.
Mobile saves drafts in on-device storage; Chrome in session storage; VS Code in webview state; CLI in memory.

execution_and_data_flow.models_and_providers: No model is called to queue or draft. The queued message is later sent through the normal turn path with the same model and route settings captured at queue time (ChatComposerNew.tsx:3925-3945). Web draft sync is switched off when an on-device model is selected.

access_and_usage.account: Web draft sync needs a signed-in session (use-conversation-draft-sync.ts:98,128). The queue and local drafts need no account on the device.
access_and_usage.permissions: The draft route filters by user, organization and non-deleted (route.ts:222-228).
access_and_usage.subscription: none found in the code for queue or draft. Sending a queued message later follows the normal plan and usage rules, which belong to SYS-subscriptions-entitlements-and-usage.
access_and_usage.limits_and_metering: Draft length cap MANAGED_CLOUD_MAX_DRAFT_LENGTH (conversation-draft.ts:3-6; value not opened); debounce 1500 ms; 3 automatic attempts; retry delay 3000 ms doubling (use-conversation-draft-sync.ts:30-31,204-206). Composer character cap from the message contract (ChatComposerNew.tsx:296).
access_and_usage.flags: none found in the code; followUpBehavior is a user setting.
access_and_usage.model_compatibility: Draft sync is excluded when the chat holds on-device model turns (use-conversation-draft-sync.ts:75-84). Steering needs a running cloud agent run id (ChatComposerNew.tsx:4430-4436).
access_and_usage.local_mode: Queue and draft work on the device. On web, a draft is not sent to the server when a local model is selected, which keeps Local text off Cloud storage (use-conversation-draft-sync.ts:75-84). Mobile marks drafts with local or cloud provenance (draftStore.ts:8).

corrections.claim: Web draft sync needs a signed-in session (use-conversation-draft-sync.ts:98,128).
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The sign-in guard is real: `if (!isLoaded || !isSignedIn || !session?.isCurrent()) return;`. It sits at line 138, and isLoaded/isSignedIn come from useSession() at line 86. Lines 98 and 128 hold neither.
corrections.correction: Web draft sync needs a loaded, signed-in, current session (use-conversation-draft-sync.ts:86,138).

corrections.section: 7 Local mode / 3 Present but disconnected / 8 test scenario
corrections.claim: Web does not sync drafts when a local model is selected or the chat holds on-device turns; 'No draft PUT is sent'.
corrections.what_the_code_shows: canDispatchDraft blocks a non-empty draft when a local model is selected or the chat holds local turns. An empty draft (`job.draft === ''`) is still dispatched, so a clear does reach the server. Temporary chats are also excluded. The cited lines 75-84 are correct for this function.
corrections.correction: With a local model selected or on-device turns in the chat, non-empty drafts are never PUT. An empty draft (clearing) is still sent so a stale server draft is removed.

corrections.claim: Debounce 1500 ms; 3 automatic attempts; retry delay 3000 ms doubling (constants at use-conversation-draft-sync.ts:30-31,204-206).
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The values are right. DRAFT_RETRY_DELAY_MS=3000 and MAX_AUTOMATIC_DRAFT_SAVE_ATTEMPTS=3 are at lines 25-26. The delay is `3000 * 2 ** (attempt-1)` at line 241, which gives 3 s then 6 s. The debounce is MANAGED_CLOUD_DRAFT_SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS (line 308), which comes from conversation-contract.json draftSaveDebounceMs: 1500. The page's 'value not opened' draft cap is draftMaxLength: 20000 in the same JSON, exported as MANAGED_CLOUD_MAX_DRAFT_LENGTH (conversations.ts:60) and enforced by zod .max() at conversations.ts:191.
corrections.correction: Constants are at lines 25-26 and the retry delay at line 241. The draft cap is 20,000 characters (conversation-contract.json), so it is not unknown.

corrections.claim: Edit: pending admission is cancelled, text and attachments return to the composer, resend replaces the slot (ChatComposerNew.tsx:4466-4481,3951-3971).
corrections.what_the_code_shows: Lines 4466-4481 are the steer handler, not Edit. The edit state is editingQueuedIdRef (lines 914, 3522-3563) and the resend path (3952-3953) consumes it. The behaviour is plausible but the first citation does not locate it.
corrections.correction: Cite 3522-3563 and 3951-3971 for edit. 4466-4481 is steering.

corrections.claim: Mobile drafts on device under 'composer-draft:' keys; account-scoped drafts cleared on sign-out (draftStore.ts:205); local or cloud provenance (draftStore.ts:8).
corrections.what_the_code_shows: PREFIX = 'composer-draft:' is at line 5. Provenance type {scope:'local'} | {scope:'cloud', ownerId} is at line 9, not 8. clearAccountScopedDrafts begins at line 200 and iterates the prefixed keys. Whether it is called on sign-out was not shown by the cited lines. The page presents the clearing as established, but the call site is uncited.
corrections.correction: The function clearAccountScopedDrafts exists (draftStore.ts:200). The sign-out call site is not cited, so that part is unverified.

missing_facts: An empty draft bypasses the local-model and on-device-turn block, so clearing a draft is still sent to the server (use-conversation-draft-sync.ts:80-83).
The server draft cap is 20,000 characters (conversation-contract.json:2, zod .max at conversations.ts:191), so the page's 'Unknown' entry for it can be closed.

Draft sync only runs for UUID conversation ids (isUuid check at use-conversation-draft-sync.ts:~158), and every save is rejected when the session or draft owner is no longer current (isCurrentDraft, lines 62-70). That is why the page's sign-out question has a partial answer.
